name: OMathBar
description: Represents an equation with a bar above or below the base.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathBar object.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.

properties.name: BarTop
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents the position of a bar in a bar object. True specifies a mathematical overbar. False specifies a mathematical underbar. Read/write.
